title: Room rent
text: Room rent. The Company shall pay Room, Boarding and Nursing expenses as provided by the Hospital, up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day, or the actual charges, whichever is lower. The eligible room category is a single private room with rent up to this limit.

title: Proportionate deduction
text: Proportionate deduction. If the Insured Person is admitted in a room category with a rent per day higher than the eligible limit specified in the Schedule, the Company shall reduce the amount payable for Associated Medical Expenses in the same proportion as the eligible rate per day bears to the actual rate per day of the room charges. Associated Medical Expenses shall not include (i) cost of pharmacy and consumables, (ii) cost of implants and medical devices, and (iii) cost of diagnostics. Proportionate deduction shall not apply in respect of Hospitals where differential billing is not followed based on room category, or in respect of expenses that are not differentially charged based on room category.

title: Intensive Care Unit
text: Intensive Care Unit. The Company shall pay ICU / ICCU expenses as billed by the Hospital. Proportionate deductions shall not be applied in respect of ICU charges, as ICU charges do not differ by room category.

title: Pre- and post-hospitalisation
text: Pre- and post-hospitalisation. Medical expenses incurred up to 30 days before admission and up to 60 days after discharge, for the same condition, are payable if the in-patient claim is admissible.

title: Non-payable items
text: Non-payable items. Items listed in Annexure I (items for which coverage is not available in the policy) are not payable.

title: Migration credit
text: Migration credit. Where this policy is issued on migration from a group health policy of the Company, the period of continuous coverage under that group policy shall be credited against the waiting periods of this policy, up to the sum insured held under the group policy.

title: Cashless
text: Cashless. Cashless treatment is available at network Hospitals on pre-authorisation by the Company or its TPA.

title: Multiple policies
text: Multiple policies. If the Insured Person holds more than one health policy, the Insured Person may choose the policy under which the claim is to be settled first; the balance may be claimed under the other policies.

title: Co-payment
text: Co-payment. Each admissible claim in respect of an Insured Person aged 61 years or above shall be subject to a co-payment of 20% of the admissible claim amount, which shall be borne by the Insured Person.

title: Grievances
text: Grievances. The Insured Person may write to the Grievance Redressal Officer of the Company and, if not satisfied, approach the Insurance Ombudsman.

title: Aggregate deductible
text: Aggregate deductible. The Company shall be liable to pay only that part of the aggregate of all admissible claims in a policy year that exceeds the Aggregate Deductible stated in the Schedule. The Aggregate Deductible may be met by payments under any other health insurance policy or by the Insured Persons themselves.

title: Claims
text: Claims. To claim, the Insured Person submits the settlement letters of other policies and the bills that together exceed the Aggregate Deductible in the policy year. Keep all hospital bills and settlement letters for this purpose.

title: Room rent
text: Room rent. No room rent limit applies; accordingly, no proportionate deduction is made under this policy.

title: Co-payment
text: Co-payment. No co-payment applies under this policy.

title: Who is covered
text: You (the employee), your spouse, up to two children up to age 25, and your dependent parents or parents-in-law (one set, chosen at enrolment).

title: Adding dependants
text: Dependants are added at joining or within 30 days of marriage or childbirth. Parents can be added only at joining or at policy renewal.

title: Sum insured
text: ₹5,00,000 per policy year, family floater. The sum insured is shared by all covered members of your family (employee, spouse, children and parents). There is no separate cover for parents.

title: Corporate buffer
text: Corporate buffer: Acme holds a buffer of ₹25,00,000 for the whole company for critical illness after a family's sum insured is used up, released at HR's discretion.

title: Room rent limit
text: Room rent limit: 1% of the sum insured per day (₹5,000 per day) for a normal room, including boarding and nursing.

title: ICU / ICCU limit
text: ICU / ICCU: up to 2% of the sum insured per day (₹10,000 per day).

title: Proportionate deduction waived
text: Proportionate deduction is waived under this group policy: if you choose a room above the limit, you pay only the extra room rent; other charges are not reduced.

title: Waiting periods
text: Pre-existing diseases are covered from day one. The 30-day initial waiting period and the specific-disease waiting periods are waived for all members.

title: Maternity
text: Maternity: up to ₹50,000 for a normal delivery or caesarean section, within the family floater. Newborn covered from day one.

title: Co-payment
text: Nil co-payment for all members, including parents, under this group policy.

title: Cover ends on leaving; migration
text: Cover for you and all your dependants ends on your last working day with Acme. There is no grace period. To keep cover, each covered member may migrate to an individual or family floater policy with Suraksha Health Insurance Ltd (SAMPLE). The migration request, with the migration form, must reach the insurer no later than 15 days before your last working day. Requests received after that are treated as fresh proposals, with medical underwriting and fresh waiting periods.

title: Migration credit
text: On migration, credit is given for the time each member has been continuously covered under this group policy, up to the sum insured held here (₹5,00,000), against waiting periods for pre-existing diseases and specific diseases.

title: Terms after migration
text: The migrated policy is a retail policy: you pay its premium, and its own terms apply. In particular, room rent limits, proportionate deduction and co-payment for older members may apply even though they are waived under this group policy.

title: Policy document prevails
text: This summary does not replace the policy document. Exclusions and definitions are as per the group policy and the insurer's standard wording.

title: Changes at renewal
text: Acme may change the group cover at renewal on 1 April each year.
